title: Canonical inverse-image intersection lattice
statement: For a morphism p:U→X of schemes and a morphism a:R→S of commutative condensed coefficient rings, let P be an S-module on X, M an R-module on U, and e:a_U^*M≅p^*P. Module categories and inverse image are those of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define the integral embedding M→Res(p^*P) by the extension adjunction. Push it forward and apply the coefficient restriction/pushforward comparison to obtain g:p_*M→Res(p_*p^*P). Define N as the categorical pullback of image(g) along the restricted unit Res(P)→Res(p_*p^*P). Its canonical inclusion N→Res(P) is monic. The construction supplies its adjoint rationalization morphism. Also prove the image-pullback localization criterion and the mates identities used to show this morphism is invertible. When both arrows are monic, the explicit imagePullbackIsoKernel identifies this intersection with the kernel of the second arrow followed by the first cokernel projection. Exact functors preserve this image-pullback via imagePullbackMapIso. Commuting isomorphisms on its three objects transport it via imagePullbackCongr.
